metadata.description: Intelligent orchestrator for the complete Platonic Coding workflow. Auto-detects intent and project state, then runs the appropriate phase—brainstorm a design, init for new projects, recover specs from existing code, refine RFCs, implement from specs with guides and tests, or review code compliance. Single unified skill with built-in design exploration.
